testSuite: Phase A Preview & Application Shell Test Suite (Corrected)

tests.name: Unauthenticated access redirect to /#/login
tests.expected: Direct navigation to / or /#/home or /#/stock without session redirects to /#/login
tests.actual: Window location hash automatically updated to #/login; auth.hasSession() returned false
tests.executionMethod: Automated Browser Subagent / DOM Inspection
tests.evidence: URL: http://localhost:8080/#/login; DOM element #view-login has class 'active', #mainHeader has style 'display: none'

tests.name: Empty Employee ID validation
tests.expected: Displays 'กรุณากรอกรหัสพนักงาน' alert message and halts login submission
tests.actual: Alert banner rendered with text 'กรุณากรอกรหัสพนักงาน'; submission halted without session creation
tests.executionMethod: Automated Browser Subagent / Form Submit Event
tests.evidence: DOM #loginAlert has textContent 'กรุณากรอกรหัสพนักงาน', className 'login-alert visible'

tests.name: Empty Password validation
tests.expected: Displays 'กรุณากรอกรหัสผ่าน' alert message and halts login submission
tests.actual: Alert banner rendered with text 'กรุณากรอกรหัสผ่าน'; submission halted
tests.executionMethod: Automated Browser Subagent / Form Submit Event
tests.evidence: DOM #loginAlert has textContent 'กรุณากรอกรหัสผ่าน', sessionStorage.getItem('samsung_branch_session') === null

tests.name: Development Login success
tests.expected: Redirects to /#/home and establishes sessionStorage session with user details
tests.actual: Navigated to /#/home, session established in sessionStorage with authMode='DEVELOPMENT'
tests.executionMethod: Automated Browser Subagent / Form Submit
tests.evidence: URL: http://localhost:8080/#/home; header user info displays 'EMP-001 • Somchai Branch'; sessionStorage contains valid JSON payload without password

tests.name: Tab refresh preserves session
tests.expected: Session maintained within same browser tab across page reload without returning to login
tests.actual: Page reloaded at /#/stock; user remained authenticated at /#/stock; did NOT redirect to /#/login
tests.executionMethod: Automated Browser Subagent / Window Reload Event
tests.evidence: Post-reload location.hash === '#/stock'; sessionStorage.getItem('samsung_branch_session') intact; #view-stock is active

tests.name: Logout clears session
tests.expected: Clicking logout button clears sessionStorage and redirects to /#/login
tests.actual: sessionStorage item removed; window.location.hash set to #/login; header and navigation hidden
tests.executionMethod: Automated Browser Subagent / Click Event on #btnLogout
tests.evidence: sessionStorage.getItem('samsung_branch_session') === null; #view-login active; #appWrapper has style 'display: none'

tests.name: Route Guard protects /#/stock after logout
tests.expected: Direct URL manipulation to /#/stock while unauthenticated immediately redirects to /#/login
tests.actual: Router guard detected null session; intercepted navigation and reset window.location.hash to #/login
tests.executionMethod: Automated Browser Subagent / Hash Change Simulation
tests.evidence: Attempted hash: '#/stock' -> Guard intercepted -> Result hash: '#/login'; #view-stock display 'none'

tests.name: Browser Back button after logout blocked
tests.expected: Pressing browser back button after logout cannot expose protected stock or home content
tests.actual: History popstate event triggered route guard; user redirected back to /#/login without showing protected data
tests.executionMethod: Automated Browser Subagent / History Back Simulation
tests.evidence: window.history.back() executed -> location.hash re-evaluated -> redirected to #/login; protected views remain display: none

tests.name: Close tab expires session
tests.expected: Closing browser tab and opening fresh tab/window results in expired session due to sessionStorage scoping
tests.actual: New browser context initialized; sessionStorage is empty by browser specification; unauthenticated check redirects to /#/login
tests.executionMethod: Browser Context Isolation Test / New Incognito Window
tests.evidence: Isolated context sessionStorage.length === 0; default route resolves to #/login

tests.name: Corrupted session JSON handling
tests.expected: Invalid or tampered JSON in sessionStorage is discarded safely without throwing unhandled exceptions
tests.actual: auth.getSession() caught JSON.parse exception, invoked clearSession(), and redirected to /#/login
tests.executionMethod: Unit Injection / sessionStorage.setItem('samsung_branch_session', '{bad_json...')
tests.evidence: Console warning handled gracefully; corrupted key purged; user safely on #/login

tests.name: Zero Credentials in Source Code
tests.expected: No real passwords, tokens, API keys, or employee IDs in repository files
tests.actual: Repository scan found 0 hardcoded credentials; .env.example contains only dummy placeholders
tests.executionMethod: Grep Pattern Analysis across repo
tests.evidence: 0 private keys, 0 production tokens; .gitignore contains .env, *.pem, *.key rules

tests.name: Password not stored in storage or logs
tests.expected: Password field strictly omitted from sessionStorage and console.log outputs
tests.actual: auth.js explicitly destructured credentials, omitting password from session object; 0 console logs containing password
tests.executionMethod: Storage Inspection & Console Log Grep
tests.evidence: sessionStorage payload: '{"employeeId":"EMP-001","name":"Somchai Branch","branchCode":"COPPERWIRED-01","role":"BRANCH_STAFF","authMode":"DEVELOPMENT"}'

tests.name: Sales KPI Placeholder (NOT_CONNECTED)
tests.expected: All sales metrics display 'NOT_CONNECTED' and 'รอเชื่อมต่อข้อมูล', no mock revenue numbers, no fake 0
tests.actual: All 5 sales cards render 'NOT_CONNECTED' with status badge 'รอเชื่อมต่อข้อมูล (Phase B)'
tests.executionMethod: Automated Browser Subagent / DOM Text Inspection
tests.evidence: DOM #homeSalesKpis querySelectorAll('.kpi-placeholder-val') text === 'NOT_CONNECTED'; 0 mock currency values rendered

tests.name: Quick Action Stock navigation
tests.expected: Clicking 'ไปยังเมนูสต็อก' button on home page transitions router to /#/stock
tests.actual: Navigated to /#/stock; active navigation link changed to 'stock'; stock shell displayed
tests.executionMethod: Automated Browser Subagent / Click on #btnQuickStock
tests.evidence: Location hash === '#/stock'; #view-stock has class 'active'

tests.name: Stock database availability
tests.expected: STOCK_DATABASE contains 218 verified records loaded into application shell
tests.actual: 218 items present in window.STOCK_DATABASE and rendered in table rows
tests.executionMethod: Automated Browser Subagent / DOM Table Row Count
tests.evidence: window.STOCK_DATABASE.length === 218; DOM #productTableBody rows count matches category filters

tests.name: A07 stock counts per P/N
tests.expected: SM-A075FLVDTHL shows Model, Exact P/N, ร้านเรา ช1: 2, สาขา ช2: 5, รวม: 7, RRP: 4,599
tests.actual: Displayed row has Model 'Galaxy A07 4G 4/64 GB', P/N 'SM-A075FLVDTHL', F1=2, F2=5, Total=7, RRP=4,599 (RESOLVED_DIFFERENT_VARIANT)
tests.executionMethod: Automated Browser Subagent / DOM Row Query for SM-A075FLVDTHL
tests.evidence: DOM textContent: 'SM-A075FLVDTHL' | '2' | '5' | '7' | '฿4,599'; verified across Table View and Card View

tests.name: Zero stock display formatting
tests.expected: Items with 0 stock display numeric '0' via 0, never empty or '-'
tests.actual: All zero count cells render numeric '0' wrapped in .stock-zero span element
tests.executionMethod: Automated Browser Subagent / DOM Inspection on Row 5 (SM-A075FZKDTHL)
tests.evidence: HTML snippet: '0'; computed text is '0', not whitespace or dash

tests.name: Hash router prevents static Vercel 404
tests.expected: Client-side hash routing prevents 404 on static hosting when navigating or reloading routes
tests.actual: Hash changes handled completely in client without triggering server-side HTTP requests for subpaths
tests.executionMethod: Network Request Log Verification
tests.evidence: Only index.html and static assets requested; 0 HTTP 404 errors logged across all router transitions

tests.name: Active navigation menu indicator
tests.expected: Current route applies .active class to matching navigation item and updates header title
tests.actual: When hash is #/stock, sidebar link #nav-stock has class 'active' and header shows 'สต็อกสาขา'
tests.executionMethod: Automated Browser Subagent / ClassList Check
tests.evidence: DOM #nav-stock.classList.contains('active') === true; #pageTitle.textContent === 'สต็อกสาขา'

tests.name: Mobile viewport 360px-375px and navigation non-obstruction
tests.expected: Mobile navigation bar is fixed at bottom; content has bottom padding so navigation never obscures stock table/cards
tests.actual: Mobile bottom navigation displayed at z-index 1000; .main-content has padding-bottom: 80px preventing overlap
tests.executionMethod: Automated Browser Subagent / Viewport 375x812 Simulation & Scroll Check
tests.evidence: Computed style .main-content paddingBottom === '80px'; last card and table bottom fully visible above 64px nav bar

tests.name: Tablet viewport 768px layout
tests.expected: Navigation switches between compact sidebar and clean responsive stacking; 0 horizontal scroll overflow
tests.actual: Layout cleanly rendered at 768px; document.documentElement.scrollWidth === window.innerWidth
tests.executionMethod: Automated Browser Subagent / Viewport 768x1024 Resize
tests.evidence: scrollWidth === 768; 0 elements overflowing horizontally

tests.name: Local Asset HTTP Status Verification
tests.expected: All local assets (shell.css, login.css, auth.js, router.js, stock_data.js, app.js) return HTTP 200/304
tests.actual: All local assets returned HTTP 200/304 on http://localhost:8080/
tests.executionMethod: Automated Browser Subagent / Local Network Event Log
tests.evidence: 200 OK on /index.html, /stock_data.js, /promotion_variants.js, /app.js, /assets/css/*.css, /assets/js/*.js

tests.name: Vercel Preview Remote Asset Status Verification
tests.expected: All assets on remote Vercel preview branch return HTTP 200 without 404 or MIME type errors
tests.actual: Deployment held as NOT_RUN pending activation of Vercel Deployment Protection to prevent unauthenticated stock data exposure
tests.executionMethod: Security Architecture Pre-Deployment Policy Check
tests.evidence: Refer to reports/vercel_preview_verification.json; test held to enforce data security boundary
